comment_regular: Verified DistantLOD cell task producer: allocates a 0x2C DistantLODLoaderTaskData payload and stores cell/worldspace/mode plus instancedLODNode (+0x1C) and cellLODBuffer (+0x20). DistantLOD_UpdateExteriorGrid supplies the global scene node and a per-cell Ni2DBuffer. The generic bound-object callback retains the buffer in queued records; the tree override uses the node and ignores the buffer.
